description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Award made to the Industrial Dispute between Mr. H. D. Thilakaratne and Ceylon Electricity Board
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an arbitration award under the Industrial Disputes Act, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. It involves statutory procedures, legal proceedings, and the enforcement of labor legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette (Type 5) rather than a government personnel or structural matter.
